episodes.title: Weekend catch-up: NROL-136 launch, Starlink for FSD, quiet labs
episodes.dek: Weekend catch-up: SpaceX NROL-136 fastest turnaround, Elon on Starlink for unsupervised FSD and AI4.5 RAM, Grok Bot updates. Anthropic, OpenAI, Nvidia, Google quiet.

sections.headline: Monday weekend catch-up
sections.dek: Everything since Friday's show through this morning.
paragraphs: Good morning. This is Leo Ward with Good Morning AI. Monday, November 23. This is the weekend catch-up, covering Saturday and Sunday through this morning at 6:30 a.m. Eastern.

sections.headline: NROL-136 launch; Starlink for FSD
sections.dek: Fastest pad turnaround. Starlink for unsupervised FSD. AI4.5 RAM reduction. Grok Bot 1.0.
paragraphs: SpaceX and xAI: SpaceX launched Falcon 9 with the NROL-136 mission from pad 4E in California on Sunday. It was 32 hours after USSF-317 from the same pad, the fastest turnaround yet. Liftoff, landing on LZ-4, and deployment confirmed. Elon Musk noted Starlink will be important for unsupervised Full Self-Driving, giving passengers high bandwidth for work and entertainment, hopefully available toward the end of next year. Except in China where it is illegal. He also posted about RAM being super expensive, so AI4.5 reduced from 32GB to 24GB, which should be fine given bandwidth constraints. There was a retweet on Grok Bot 1.0 updates including team bots and joining meetings. No new Starship launch in the window.
